description: This PHP file handles AJAX requests to set MoCA (Multimedia over Coax Alliance) configuration parameters. It performs validation on incoming data, manages user session authentication, and updates configuration settings via str-setting functions.

methods.name: isValInArray
methods.description: Validates if a given value exists within an array of acceptable values.

methods.name: setStr
methods.description: Sets a configuration string value for device settings using specific keys.
